sky arts.desc: A look at the Beatles legend's honest and heartfelt final interview, intertwined with footage and commentary from friends as December 2020 marks the 40th anniversary of his death.

sky arts.title: Johnny Cash: Live At Montreux
sky arts.desc: The late Johnny Cash brought his inimitable sound to the Montreux Festival in 1994, featuring favourites from across his career including Folsom Prison Blues and more.

sky arts.title: Johnny Cash: The Man In Black In Britain
sky arts.desc: Documentary exploring Johnny Cash's connection with Britain, featuring testimonies from his own children and friends like Elvis Costello.

sky arts.title: Cream: Reunion - Live At The Royal Albert HaIl
sky arts.desc: In one of the most highly anticipated gigs ever, Cream reunite at the Royal Albert Hall - almost 40 years after their farewell concert on the same stage.

sky cinema premiere.title: Cold Storage
sky cinema premiere.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

sky cinema premiere.title: Mother's Pride
sky cinema premiere.desc: About a failing pub, a divided community, and a grieving family whose lives are changed by brewing real ale and entering the Great British Beer Awards.

sky cinema premiere.title: The Deb
sky cinema premiere.desc: Two teenage cousins dig deep to find self-acceptance and a date to the Debutante Ball in a small country town in Australia.

sky cinema action.title: Olympus Has Fallen
sky cinema action.desc: America's national security team must rely on a disgraced former guard to save the president after terrorists seize control of the White House, taking the chief of state hostage.

sky cinema action.title: Chaos
sky cinema action.desc: A veteran detective is teamed with a rookie cop when they are sent to negotiate with a bunch of criminals holding a bank hostage. It transpires that a master thief has planted a computer virus that will drain funds from the bank's accounts. The detective faces a race against time to catch the thief and stop the randomly evolving computer virus, which models its behaviour on the bewildering principles of chaos theory.

sky cinema family.title: The Borrowers
sky cinema family.desc: Based on the Mary Norton novels about a four-inch-tall family who live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

sky cinema family.title: Jumanji
sky cinema family.desc: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

sky cinema family.title: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle
sky cinema family.desc: Four teens embark on the adventure of a lifetime when a video game magically transports them to the jungle and transforms them into adults.

sky cinema comedy.title: Finding Your Feet
sky cinema comedy.desc: A middle-class snob on the eve of retirement takes refuge with her bohemian sister after she discovers her husband is having an affair with her best friend.

sky cinema comedy.title: Hot Fuzz
sky cinema comedy.desc: Hot-shot police officer Nicholas Angel smells foul play when the residents of a sleepy Somerset village start to die in terrible `accidents'. Something's afoot, but can he - and daft local plod Danny Butterman - find out what?

sky cinema comedy.title: Bean: The Ultimate Disaster Movie
sky cinema comedy.desc: Mr Bean has somehow managed to get a job as a security guard. His latest assignment finds him travelling to America as an art expert, looking after the famous `Whistler's Mother' painting as it is transported from Britain to a posh new Los Angeles museum. The catch is that Bean is no art expert and his trip was a ploy by his British employers to get rid of him. Unfortunately, no one has warned the Americans about Mr Bean.

sky cinema comedy.title: Mr Bean's Holiday
sky cinema comedy.desc: Mr Bean is going on holiday to the south of France, looking for a quiet and sunny trip in the Riviera. However, his trip doesn't go as smoothly as he expected when he has to face a series of misunderstandings and totally unfortunate coincidences. Eventually, Mr Bean will end up spoiling the last film of the snobbish director Carson Clay and appearing by accident at the Cannes Film Festival.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: The Autobots and the Decepticons become involved in a space race to find a hidden Cybertronian spacecraft stranded on the Moon. Sam Witwicky must come to the aid of the Autobots to defeat the evil Decepticons to stop them discovering the secrets of the Cybertronian craft.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Cold Storage
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A highly contagious and rapidly mutating microorganism starts to multiply as it unleashes its brain-controlling, body-bursting terrors at a former military base.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: Waterworld
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: Big-budget tale of the battle for survival in a world where dry land has disappeared with the melting of the polar ice caps. One man, who has become amphibious, tries to protect survivors on an artificial atoll made from scrap metal by taking on a gang of marauding pirates. He is also intent on discovering if there is any truth in the myth that there is still some land left above water.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: A resourceful teen takes her younger sister's place in a brutal contest in which youths from each of 12 districts fight to the death on live television.

sky cinema sci-fi/horror.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
sky cinema sci-fi/horror.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever.

sky cinema thriller.title: Snatch
sky cinema thriller.desc: Based on three hybridising narrative strands, three groups of villains are intent on retrieving a missing diamond. Turkish and Tommy team up with a pugilistic Irish gypsy named Mickey for the purpose of rigging unlicensed boxing matches. However, their opponent also arranges some dodgy betting with the courier of the stolen diamond, who subsequently goes missing. To complicate further, a New York gangster arrives on the scene.

sky cinema thriller.title: The Girl on the Train
sky cinema thriller.desc: A divorced train commuter passes the house she used to live in with her husband every day. To distract herself she creates a fictional perfect world for her former neighbours in her head. This is ruined when one of the neighbours goes missing.

sky cinema thriller.title: No Country for Old Men
sky cinema thriller.desc: A man stumbles on the aftermath of a drug deal and takes off with the loot, but the bad guys are in hot pursuit.

sky cinema thriller.title: Dog Day Afternoon
sky cinema thriller.desc: A desperate and crazed man, with the help of an accomplice, takes a local Brooklyn bank hostage with plans to rob it in order to pay for his lover's sex-change operation.

sky cinema greats.title: The Fifth Element
sky cinema greats.desc: A futuristic cab driver's latest passenger, a woman created from an alien cell, may be mankind's last hope of saving Earth from impending doom.

sky cinema greats.title: Highlander
sky cinema greats.desc: From the Scottish Highlands of the 16th century to present-day New York, immortal Connor MacLeod is unable to escape his destiny and must battle against his fellow warriors.

sky cinema greats.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves
sky cinema greats.desc: On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.

sky cinema greats.title: The Mummy
sky cinema greats.desc: The curse of an ancient mummy protects buried treasure in the Egyptian desert. An American mercenary who knows of the secret location is rescued from a Cairo prison by an English historian and her brother, and together they set off on a hunt. Along the way, the trio encounter flesh-eating scarab beetles, killer sandstorms, and reincarnated demons.

sky cinema drama.title: Dreamgirls
sky cinema drama.desc: Following the adventures of The Dreamettes, an all-girl singing group. They're going nowhere fast until they meet fast-talking car salesman-come-manager who has ambitions to make a fortune selling black music to a white audience. He persuades them to become backing singers for James `Thunder' Early, but the larger-than-life lead singer Effie White must step out of the spotlight in favour of the more image-friendly Deena Jones.

sky cinema drama.title: Materialists
sky cinema drama.desc: A young, ambitious New York City matchmaker finds herself torn between the perfect match and her imperfect ex.

sky cinema drama.title: Empire of the Sun
sky cinema drama.desc: Young Jim has to grow up fast after the Japanese invade Shanghai. Separated from his parents and alone in a prisoner of war camp, Jim must fight to survive.

sky cinema drama.title: True Grit
sky cinema drama.desc: When her father is murdered, young 14-year-old girl Mattie Ross hires grizzled US Marshal Rooster Cogburn to track down the killer into hostile Indian territory. Based on Charles Portis' novel.
